notes: Avg FP = our in-season projection per game (own_proj: minutes x rates; the daily 'own' base). Peak FP = expected best game in a 3-game week, with his own peak shape (model/s1_inseason.py)
GW exp = gw_value on Avg / Peak: his games that GW, chance he plays (ESPN Out, availability), best game counts, safety net. An Out player is worth his safety-net sub (marked Out)
best/GW = this season's average of his best game in each GW he played (raw box scores): a cross-check, ignores next GW's schedule and injuries
rivals = entries within 40 places, Ryan's own left out; template = top-50 own 50%+; differential = rival own < 15%
gain = exp in - exp out; it is the same against every rival. swing = change in points on which you and an average rival differ (+ = more swing, for chasing; - = less, for protecting)
singles only; sell price = current price (assumed, consistent with budget = squad value + bank)
free transfers = remaining after GW 5 + 2, cap 24 (derived from the API rule)
